query: UPDATE central.recovery_epoch_workspaces AS work SET cursor_created_at = $4, cursor_run_id = $5, scanned_count = scanned_count + 1, reconciled_count = reconciled_count + 1, claim_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds', retry_not_before = NULL, failure_class = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE work.epoch_generation = $1 AND work.workspace_id = $2 AND work.delivery_state = 'claimed' AND work.claim_token_hash = $3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM central.recovery_epochs epoch WHERE epoch.epoch_generation = work.epoch_generation AND epoch.coordinator_domain = $6)
